listing.title: Puma Black Backpack
listing.description: A sleek black backpack from Puma featuring a durable exterior with a prominent Puma logo on the front. The backpack includes a spacious main compartment with a zipper, adjustable shoulder straps for comfort, and a top handle for convenient carrying.

listing.title: Women's Black Open Front Cardigan
listing.description: This women's black open front cardigan features a lightweight fabric perfect for layering. Its long sleeves and classic black color make it versatile for both casual and office wear. Pair it with your favorite tops and bottoms for a stylish, comfortable look.

listing.title: Samsung Blue Cycling Jersey with Red Accents
listing.description: A stylish blue cycling jersey featuring Samsung branding on the chest. It has short sleeves and a zip-up front, with red accents on the collar and sides for a sporty look. Comfortable and suitable for cycling activities.
